in the Republic of Armenia the medicinal products shall be registered under the simplified procedure 
and general procedure in case of existence of a positive assessment report.  
 
 
 
11. The simplified procedure for registration of medicinal product shall be applied to medicinal 
products registered in ICH Member State or to pre-qualified medicinal products of World Health 
Organisation (hereinafter referred to as “the WHO”)(hereinafter referred to as “the reference 
competent authority”) within the time periods prescribed by point 20 of this Rule. 
12. In all other cases the general procedure for registration of medicinal product shall be applied 
within the time periods prescribed by point 19 of this Rule.

calendar days, which shall include the time period of assessment for the purpose of registration the
